ats.reason: Clean, well-ordered single-column text with standard headings and honest keywords; Azure Monitor/monitoring and Ansible from the source CV are missing, and 'DevOps' only appears as part of 'Azure DevOps'.

issues: Orphaned paragraph 'That work required leading the technical delivery...' placed after the certifications sentence, so 'That work' refers ambiguously and repeats the migration point

strengths: Concrete, accurate metrics and Terraform networking detail

evaluation.summary: The CV is accurate, well structured and ATS-friendly, presenting the candidate's Azure, Terraform, networking and migration work with real metrics and honestly explaining both career gaps. Gaps against the ad (AWS, Terragrunt, mTLS, IoT, JVM) are not faked, though Azure Monitor was dropped despite the ad's observability focus. The cover letter is specific and truthful but has a misplaced, repetitive paragraph and does little to bridge the Azure-to-AWS and train-connectivity context. Layout is clean; page 2 of the CV is light.
